answers.text: Cortisol stimulates gluconeogenesis, the formation of new glucose in the liver
Cortisol stimulates tissues to use free fatty acids for energy instead of glucose
Cortisol stimulates protein breakdown to use proteins instead of glucose for energy
Cortisol inhibits protein synthesis in most body cells, in an effort to use the proteins as energy rather than glucose

params.textField: Let’s reflect on the last activity. If cortisol stimulates hunger, the person with excessive amounts of glucocorticoids in the body, like those taking oral corticosteroids for their asthma for long periods of time, would be likely to *gain weight*. If they are breaking up their proteins and degrading them, they will wind up with *thin skin* and their blood vessels would be breaking down as well, yielding *easy bruising*. If they are increasing glucose levels by all these mechanisms, they would be likely to have a type of *diabetes mellitus* after long term treatment.

params.textField: When a client needs to take ‘corticosteroids’ (glucocorticoids like prednisone or prednisolone) for a long period of time, their appearance is likely to change. This is termed iatrogenic (caused by a medication or other type of treatment) Cushing’s syndrome. But why does this happen? We have discussed some of those changes in the last activity, and here we discuss more. One of the stressors that the hypothalamus may be responding to is anaphylactic shock, which involves the immune system overresponding to an allergen. Therefore, one of the actions of cortisol and other glucocorticoids is to severely *decrease all arms of the immune system*, which may result in fungal or other types of infections. Another action of the glucocorticoids is to save fat in areas that are easily accessible and as such the face becomes fuller, termed *moon face* the abdomen becomes *pendulous* and *fat pads* develop on the shoulders. Finally, the ACTH secreted by the pituitary gland will also stimulate the release of androgens at the level of the adrenal cortex, and women will often complain of *increased body and facial hair and acne*
